[size=5][b]ABOUT:[/b][/size]

This spreadsheet tool takes formatted text and creates corresponding i18n keys. It was primarily created to make i18n file creation for Stardew Valley modding just a little bit easier, because if CK had to copy and paste one more line of text, their brain would have eaten itself :DDD

Simply go to File -> Make a Copy and save it to your own Google Drive.

[b][size=5]NOTES:[/size][/b]

Do NOT try to export this sheet to Excel/.xlsx format. It does not work in Excel. I'm working on an Excel version but it's proving to be far more finicky than I'd thought.

Once the Excel version is functional, it will be uploaded here. Currently, the file for download is just a .txt file with a link to the Google Sheet above.
